data.standardized_narrative: The syndicate reported a mixed prior year development for 2023. While there was an improvement in prior year reserves for 2022 and 2021 due to good experience on longer tail and specialty classes, the 2021 year of account ultimately closed at a small loss due to meaningful loss activity from events such as Hurricane Ida, Winter storm Uri, European and Australian floods, and the Ukraine conflict.

data.data_quality_notes: Gross prior year development not quantified. Narrative indicates a mixed direction with 'improvement in prior year reserves for 2022 & 2021' but also '2021 year of account closed at a small loss'. Claims development triangle on page 17 is limited to 2021-2023 and does not show older years, and is affected by External RITC movements of (216.5) for 2020 and prior years, making it unsuitable for calculating prior year development.
